item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Trump, Xi and Putin are set to meet in China for a three-way summit, while U.S. envoys say Europe will join any ensuing Ukraine peace talks after recent meetings with Putin. Russia dispatched a major business delegation to Kabul for talks with the Taliban, linking its diplomatic outreach to the broader conflict. A car bomb in Russia killed a military officer and wounded a former adviser to Ukraine’s ex-pro-Russia prime minister, and a cyberattack struck a German drone manufacturer that supplies Ukraine. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israel struck Gaza’s Nasser Hospital, killing six people including a doctor, a child and a senior Hamas commander inside the facility. Heavy rains have flooded tens of thousands of tents in Gaza, threatening power and healthcare access and leading to a baby’s death from cold. Humanitarian agencies are urging swift entry of winter supplies as the humanitarian situation worsens amid disputes between Israel and Hamas. A former Hamas bodyguard was identified after being granted British citizenship and alleged to have plotted a terror attack. The United Nations reported 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Israel and Hezbollah: the situation
item.description:
Israel has stepped up strikes in southern Lebanon, hitting Qantara, causing an explosion in Khiam and flying drones over Beirut, while an overflight wounded a Lebanese footballer. The Lebanese army seized a large weapons cache in a Beirut suburb warehouse and another depot in the city’s southern suburbs. Hezbollah arrested five members in Batroun, continued artillery fire on Israeli positions and began cash payments to war victims and displaced families. UNRWA funding cuts have deepened hardship for Palestinian refugees in Lebanon. The conflict has caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:
The Houthis have renewed attacks on Saudi Arabia, striking the East West oil pipeline and a pumping station. Saudi forces say they intercepted missiles and drones, with debris falling near Mecca, which the Houthis deny targeting. Pakistan has called for an immediate end to Houthi attacks as the UN Security Council renews Yemen sanctions. France’s foreign ministry spokesperson says France favours adding pressure on the Houthis, and the conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Iraq: the situation
item.description:
Iran-backed suspects are accused of planning attacks on a U.K. air base that hosts U.S. jets in Iraq, while an Iran-backed trio is linked to a drone strike that disabled the Khor Mor gas field in Iraqi Kurdistan. Iraqi security officials have expanded air-defence deployments, created a special security force and an energy police unit to protect pipelines and curb oil smuggling, and are sending a delegation to Lebanon to assist the inquiry into former MP Ahmed al-Alwani’s death. The conflict remains low-level but sees coordinated Iranian proxy actions against both military and energy targets, and a new diplomatic outreach to Lebanon. 396 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Sudan's civil war: the situation
item.description:
The Sudanese army has seized Bakori and Sali in West Kordofan and recaptured Al-Khuwai and other areas in West and North Kordofan from the RSF, while the RSF continues drone strikes that killed nine civilians in the Blue Nile. The army shot down an RSF drone that crossed from Ethiopia, adding to reports of drones being launched across the border. Gold smuggled from Sudan is being routed through Ethiopia to the UAE, which remains the main destination for the illicit metal. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Ethiopia: the situation
item.description:
Federal forces have taken additional Tigray cities while fighting persists, and severe drought and prolonged conflict are driving acute hunger in Amhara, Tigray and Afar. Ethiopian drones are now operating over Sudan and RSF drones are launching from Ethiopian territory against Sudanese targets, prompting diplomatic expulsions and consular closures. An RPG strike near a school in Moyale killed dozens of Ethiopian Orthodox believers and a Kenyan, and attacks on Orthodox Christians continue in Arsi, Benishangul Gumuz and the north, with blasts heard in Addis Ababa. Seed insecurity threatens Tigray farmers and a psychosocial and spiritual care pilot is being tested, while displacement exceeds 50,000 people, and 2,824 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

In Kaduna, IDPs demanded the release of four abducted members who remain in captivity and bandits killed a farmer after receiving a N56 million ransom. Armed thugs attacked Peter Obi opposition rallies and NDC supporters in Lagos, killing supporters and prompting a police probe. Sudanese Arab refugees fleeing to Chad near the CAR border face hostility and distrust from local populations, and a man deported from Minnesota to CAR reports his life is at high risk.
